title: Expert Pizza Chef
responsibilities: Complete management of the pizzeria section: preparing dough according to traditional recipes, hand-stretching, topping, wood-fired oven cooking, cleaning and equipment maintenance.
experience_required: Minimum 4 years proven experience as a pizza chef, preferably with a wood-fired oven. Autonomy and speed required.
full_details_for_prompt: Job Opening: Expert Pizza Chef in Rome (Lazio) at Trattoria Bella Napoli. Requires at least 4 years experience with wood-fired ovens. Full management of the pizza section, including dough, stretching, cooking. Permanent contract, evening shifts 6 PM-12 AM Tue-Sun. Net monthly salary €1900-€2300. Benefit: Staff meals.
pre_assessment_questions: Do you have specific experience working with wood-fired pizza ovens?
Are you comfortable managing the entire pizza-making process independently, including dough preparation?
Are you available to work the required evening shifts (6 PM - 12 AM) from Tuesday to Sunday?

title: Waiter/Waitress
hours_description: Full-time (40 hours), lunch and dinner shifts, weekend and holiday availability required.
responsibilities: Welcoming and managing customers, presenting menus and wines, taking orders (including handheld devices), table service, clearing and resetting tables, managing payments.
experience_required: Minimum 1 year experience in a similar role in quality restaurants. Excellent Italian and good English required. Customer service oriented.
full_details_for_prompt: Position Available: Waiter/Waitress at Ristorante Centrale in Milan (Lombardy). 12-month fixed-term contract, full-time 40 hours/week on lunch/dinner shifts, including weekends and holidays. Salary €1650 net monthly plus tips. Duties: welcoming guests, taking orders, service, cashier. Requires at least 1 year experience, good English. Benefits: Training, Meal Vouchers.
pre_assessment_questions: Do you have experience using handheld devices or POS systems for order taking?
Are you available to work full-time, including lunch/dinner shifts, weekends, and holidays as required?
Do you consider your English language skills to be good enough for serving international customers?
Are you comfortable working in a fast-paced restaurant environment?

title: Chef de Partie (Pasta Station)
hours_description: Full-time, 5 days/week (rotating days off), single or split shifts.
responsibilities: Responsible for the pasta station: preparing the line, cooking fresh pasta and risotto, managing ingredients and stock, adhering to HACCP standards.
experience_required: At least 3 years experience as a Chef de Partie (pasta). Culinary diploma preferred. Knowledge of Tuscan cuisine.
full_details_for_prompt: Osteria Toscana in Florence seeks a Chef de Partie for the pasta station. Permanent contract, full-time 5 days/week. Net monthly salary €2000-€2400 depending on experience. Responsibilities: pasta line preparation, cooking pasta/risotto to order, stock management, HACCP compliance. Requires at least 3 years experience in the role and knowledge of Tuscan cuisine.
pre_assessment_questions: Do you have at least 3 years of experience specifically managing a pasta station?
Are you knowledgeable about preparing both fresh pasta and risotto dishes?
Are you familiar with and committed to following HACCP standards in the kitchen?
Are you willing to work rotating days off, including potential split shifts?

title: Barista / Bartender
salary_description: CCNL Tourism Contract - Level to be defined
hours_description: Seasonal April-October, full-time, shifts including nights.
responsibilities: Preparing coffee drinks, aperitifs, international cocktails, managing the bar counter and table service, inventory.
experience_required: Previous experience as Barista/Bartender in hotels or high-level bars. English proficiency essential, second language appreciated. HACCP certification.
full_details_for_prompt: Barista / Bartender needed for Hotel Excelsior in Venice Lido for the April-October season. Seasonal full-time contract (CCNL Turismo), level based on experience. Shift work, including nights. Duties: coffee, aperitifs, cocktails, bar/table service. Requires previous experience, excellent English, HACCP. Meals and accommodation potentially provided.
pre_assessment_questions: Are you proficient in making a wide range of coffee drinks and international cocktails?
Are you available to work the full season from April to October, including night shifts?
Is your English proficiency sufficient for interacting with international hotel guests?
Do you currently hold a valid HACCP certification?
